title: Setting basePath causes parallel dynamic route modals to break

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: Linking and Navigating
labels.description: Related to Next.js linking (e.g., <Link>) and navigation.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/hmacafee/nextgram_basepath

### To Reproduce

Including a fork of the `nextgram` repo here: https://github.com/hmacafee/nextgram_basepath

1. Clone the fork
2. Run the app locally by running `yarn`, `yarn run dev`
3. Navigate to `localhost:3000/test-path` to see the app
4. Click any of the images to see the broken modal behavior 

### Current vs. Expected behavior

The root route no longer displays behind the modal. The root route should still display behind the modal when using parallel dynamic routes for a modal, but it no longer does when employing a `basePath`.

### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release
